faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEPA Senior Shift Incharge recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Shift Incharge post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation in Science. Preference will be given to those with a degree in Pulp & Paper Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 50 years as of 14 September 2026. Age relaxations are applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Shift Incharge position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Shift Incharge post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Shift Incharge role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 55,000/- per month, which is negotiable and inclusive of all allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NEPA Senior Shift Incharge recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Senior Shift Incharge position?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a contractual basis for the Senior Shift Incharge position.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Newsprint and Paper Mills located?
faq.answer: National Newsprint and Paper Mills (NEPA) is located in Nepanagar, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 450221.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Shift Incharge post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Shift Incharge post will be based on an Interview.
